in_hebrew.name: Schuyler
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Schuyler הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Dutch 'skuylen', meaning 'to shower'. The name Schuyler was popular in the Netherlands and was later brought to America by Dutch settlers. It has been a common name in the United States since the late 18th century.
